speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. At 8 months old, you've been experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension; have these symptoms been present since birth, or did they start recently? Additionally, have you noticed any vomiting, particularly if it is projectile or green in color?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung disease (suspected based on age and symptoms, pending further confirmation). Please wait for test results.

REQUEST TEST: Anorectal manometry, Rectal biopsy. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray, Abdominal_Ultrasound.
